name: Stat tile
summary: A KPI stat tile: one headline figure, its change against the previous period as an absolute number and a percent, and a comparison caption, on a flat Vivid Pink at 5% card with a Vivid Pink top bar.
highlights: Large semibold value, change as absolute and percent
Rise in black with an up arrow, fall in a black pill with a down arrow
1 to 6 tiles per row, wrapping on narrow screens
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-stat-tile> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Give it `value` and `previous` and it works out the change: the absolute difference and a whole percent of the previous value (percentage points for `format="percent"`), followed by the `caption` that names the comparison. A rise is plain black with an up arrow; a fall is white on a black pill with a down arrow (colour rule 7.3), so direction never depends on a status hue. The card is flat: Vivid Pink at 5% with a 4px Vivid Pink top bar and black text (`look="accent"`), or white with a border (`look="plain"`). One KPI row counts as the screen's one highlighted panel (colour rule 3.7); use the plain look when the screen already has one. Lay 1 to 6 tiles in a row with <aha-grid columns="N" responsive>, which wraps them on narrow screens. The same look renders into a static report image; see the Report images guideline.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. The change is computed in the element, so every consumer rounds and words it the same way.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: flat, radius 8, padding 20/20/16, Vivid Pink at 5% (#E70E680D, #FEF3F7 on white) with a 4px Vivid Pink top bar; plain look white with a 1px #E3E3E3 border and the same bar

spec.label: Label
spec.value: 14/1.5 Regular #1A1A1A (text on Vivid Pink at 5% is black, colour rule 6.5)

spec.label: Value
spec.value: 32/1.2 SemiBold #1A1A1A, tabular figures; format number (grouped), compact (12.5K, 1.3M) or percent (whole %)

spec.label: Change
spec.value: 14/1.5 SemiBold, absolute + whole percent of the previous value, e.g. 1,460 (13%); percentage points for a percent value. Rise: black with system-arrow-up 16. Fall: white on a #1A1A1A pill with system-arrow-down 16. No change: the flat label, no arrow

spec.label: Caption
spec.value: 14/1.5 Regular #4A4A4A after the change, names the comparison (vs previous week)

spec.label: Row
spec.value: 1 to 6 tiles in <aha-grid columns="N" responsive gap="middle">, 16px gap, wrapping as the container narrows

props.name: value
props.desc: The current figure. A non-numeric value is shown as given and no change is computed

props.name: previous
props.desc: The figure for the previous period. Omit it to show the value alone

props.name: caption
props.desc: The comparison, shown after the change in secondary text (vs previous week)

props.name: format
props.desc: number groups thousands; compact gives 12.5K / 1.3M; percent reads the value as a fraction (0.46 → 46%) and shows the change in percentage points

props.name: look
props.desc: accent: Vivid Pink at 5% card. plain: white card with a border, for a screen that already has its one highlighted panel

props.name: rise-label · fall-label · flat-label · points-label
props.desc: Copy for screen readers (rise, fall), the no-change text and the percentage-point unit; pass translations here

whenToUse.when: a KPI with a comparison against the previous period, on a dashboard, a report screen or a report image
a bare headline number with no previous period to compare against, inline in a panel
how a figure moved over many periods, not just against the last one

opinion.note: Name the metric in sentence case and always say what the change is compared with in the caption. Direction is shape, not hue: never tint a tile, the value or the change green or red. One KPI row is the screen's one highlighted panel; if the screen already has another, use look="plain". Keep a row to 6 tiles at most.
